 Rules can wait! Anna Leigh Waters tells pickleball newbies to just have fun

 BNC Staff 
 19 hours ago 
 SHARE 
 BY EDISON JOSEPH GONZALES
 Forget mastering the rules on your first try. For world No. 1 pickleball player Anna Leigh Waters, getting into the sport should begin with something simpler: hitting the ball, enjoying the game and allowing the rules to come with experience.
 Waters encouraged newcomers not to become preoccupied with understanding every rule during their first few games, saying the pressure to figure everything out can lead to frustration.
 “Honestly, when you go out there, everybody talks about the rules. The rules are so hard. You have to know the rules,” Waters said in an interview on BNC’s “The Daily Dish.”
 She offered a different approach for those just starting out.
 “But the first couple of times you play pickleball, you don’t really need to worry about the rules or what’s going on. You just need to have fun and hit the ball around, because the more you play, the more the rules will just come to you,” she said.
 Waters acknowledged that beginners can become discouraged when they struggle to understand the game.
 “And I feel like a lot of people get maybe upset or frustrated because they can’t figure out what’s going on,” she said.
 Her advice is to keep the first few experiences enjoyable rather than allow confusion over the rules to get in the way.
 “But just go have fun with it the first couple of times. You’ll love it,” Waters said.
